title: Chief Technology Officer
excerpt: Built v1 of a multifamily real estate marketing analytics SaaS and grew it from zero to $1.2M ARR in nine months through data-driven product strategy.
html:
Built the first version of a multifamily real estate marketing data and analytics platform, measuring net operating income gaps and marketing funnel performance.

Grew the product from zero to $600K ARR at six months and $1.2M ARR at nine months through data-driven product strategy, while hiring and leading a hybrid onsite/remote design and engineering team of 10+.

Implemented a progressive feature rollout strategy that balanced manual operations against automation — shipping customer value ahead of full automation.
